name: @pinyinduck/android
description: Gradle wrapper for the PinyinDuck Android input method
comment: This package is a Gradle project. Gradle is the build system; this file exists only to
make `packages/android` a recognisable member of the npm workspace, so `npm install` at
the repository root does not try to treat it as an application.
There are no npm scripts here on purpose. Build, test and lint are Gradle tasks:
./gradlew check                  # tests plus the coverage gate
